e: My friend sees working from home in a positive light.
그 친구는 늘 긍정적이라서 같이 있으면 기분이 좋아요.
That friend is always positive, so I feel good when I'm with them.
The interviewer's reaction was positive, so I'm hopeful.
긍정적.x: 반대말은 “부정적”이에요. “긍정”은 “맞다”고 받아들이는 것이라서, 질문에 “네”라고 답하는 것도 긍정이에요.
긍정적.xe: The opposite is 부정적 (negative). 긍정 means accepting something as true or right, so answering “네” to a question is also 긍정.

e: The floral pattern on this curtain is pretty.
꽃무늬.x: 꽃 모양으로 된 무늬예요. '꽃무늬 원피스'처럼 다른 명사 앞에 붙여 써요.
꽃무늬.xe: A pattern made of flowers. It often comes before another noun, as in '꽃무늬 원피스'.

e: I need hangers for my new room.
Hang your coat on a hanger.
My clothes are wet. Please hang them on a hanger.
p: to have a good build for clothes (everything looks good on them)
그 배우는 키가 커서 옷걸이가 좋아요.
used about someone whose build makes any clothes look good
옷걸이.x: “걸이”는 “걸다(hang)”에서 왔어요. 목걸이, 귀걸이, 옷걸이 모두 거는 물건이에요.
옷걸이.xe: 걸이 comes from 걸다 (to hang). 목걸이, 귀걸이 and 옷걸이 are all things you hang something on or hang on yourself.

e: My friend gives me chocolate on my birthday.
Chocolate is too sweet. I only eat a little.
p: 운동을 열심히 해서 초콜릿 복근이 생겼어요.
배 근육이 초콜릿 조각처럼 나뉘어 보여서 이렇게 말해요.
called this because the stomach muscles look divided like pieces of chocolate
초콜릿.x: 한국에서는 2월 14일에 초콜릿을 주고, 한 달 뒤 3월 14일 “화이트데이”에는 사탕을 줘요. 말할 때는 “초코”라고 줄여요.
초콜릿.xe: In Korea, chocolate is given on February 14, and candy is given a month later on March 14, called White Day. In speech, people often shorten 초콜릿 to 초코.

e: I hurt my leg and got treated at the hospital.
If you get treatment, you will get better soon.
p: I'm receiving treatment at the hospital now.
치료가 아직 계속되고 있을 때 써요.
Used when the treatment is still going on.
If it hurts a lot, get treated quickly.
상대에게 치료를 권할 때 쓰는 존댓말이에요.
A polite way to advise someone to get treatment.
After getting treatment, I got much better.
치료가 끝난 다음의 일을 말할 때 써요.
Used to talk about what happened after the treatment.
치료받다.x: 치료를 받는다는 뜻이에요. 의사는 '치료하다', 환자는 '치료받다'를 써요.
치료받다.xe: It means to get medical treatment. Doctors 치료하다; patients 치료받다.
